trigger: news: BIS Entity List adds 7 SE Asian intermediaries
what_changed: News: on 2026-11-23 BIS added seven Megaspeed-group firms (MSFusion, PT Megaspeed International, Speedmatrix in Malaysia; Apex Enterprise Solutions (Alibaba), Megaspeed International, Swiftdata in Singapore; Megaspeed (Thailand)) to the Entity List, all EAR items under a presumption of denial (FR 2026-23999) [src 228, src 229]. This hit the SE Asia thesis trigger in part: it names firms, not a country-wide licence suspension, and NVIDIA had already put Megaspeed on its no-sell list in June 2025 [src 230, src 232]. Kilian re-opened the Nov 10 card and picked 'Book the Other region loss' (2026-11-25), then 'Keep the floor': hs_capture and acie FY28-29 x0.978 (NVIDIA's 'Other' region billing, FY26 $4,299M, $4,299M [src 40] = 2.2% of FY26 Data Center $193,737M [src 84], assuming all 'Other' billing is Data Center); the supply floor k recomputed by its rule 1.265627 -> 1.294097, so FY28 revenue stays $725.0B, FY29 $900.1B; ACIE FY28 277,747 / FY29 368,106; target $284.11 (base round re-valued on this date: 284.11 before the booking, 283.88 at the base round's date). Every judgment alternative that patches hs_capture / acie values or a floor-rule k was re-based (x0.978, k / 0.978) so it builds the same as before; re-sized. Owed: Q3 FY27 interest ($358M) re-check, 10-Q not filed as of 2026-11-24 (EDGAR).
